scope: Inherited DeerFlow2.1.0 versus Onyx4.8.3 comparison, with fixed GPTR3.7.0 as a matched baseline; source-only proposals do not decide the winner

comparison_modes.selection_policy: Absent or null selection preserves the prior full_usage rules. quality_only requires accepted exact shared/job/preregistration bindings before candidate outputs; this draft selects no mode and remains ineligible for freeze.

full_usage.usage_requirements: All prior complete authoritative aggregate, all-call usage, original-operand and efficiency-tie conditions remain unchanged. Unknown usage cannot fall through to agent time.

quality_decision.fixed_reference: gpt-researcher cannot be replaced by this study
quality_decision.strict_supported_reports: Per unchanged question/arm, integer count from 0 to 2 of native C verdicts over exactly two valid repeats under the frozen Inspect strict criterion; I=0. Native UNSCORED/errors invalidate the whole matched block and cannot shrink the denominator.
quality_decision.official_rubric: Per question/arm, arithmetic mean of the two unchanged official DRB-II total scores, with original rubric item values, dimension scores, blocked_rate, field presence and failures retained separately. Bind complete original rubric coverage and its native disposition before freeze; do not substitute the rubric total for strict citation support.
quality_decision.minimum: Onyx strict-supported report count and mean official rubric score must each be greater than or equal to DeerFlow on every one of the eight matched questions.
quality_decision.improvement: At least one question must have strict-supported count greater by at least 1 or mean official rubric score strictly greater than DeerFlow, without any loss under minimum. Freeze the native numeric field, complete-coverage and failure dispositions before outputs; no post-hoc rounding or tolerance.
qualifying_challenger_order: onyx is the sole challenger for the DeerFlow slot
quality_decision.quality_tie: If every quality value ties, retain DeerFlow2.1.0. No usage, elapsed-time or footprint tiebreak.
quality_decision.otherwise: Keep DeerFlow2.1.0; GPTR3.7.0 stays the fixed matched reference.

quality_only.grader_binding_scope: Keep inspect-grader-binding.json native scorer, default instructions/pattern, required grader role, partial_credit=false, strict Sample.target criterion, parse/coverage acceptance and all negative controls unchanged. Its original efficiency-operand and complete-accounting prerequisites apply to full_usage; quality_only still requires original missingness/presence, scoped grader/helper observations and independent actual grader delivery identity.
quality_only.outcome_inventory: Retain all 16 task-repeat blocks, 48 planned reports and every grading/helper/retry/invalid/recovery attempt, original report/source observations and native values/reasons/dispositions. No selective exclusions, altered denominator, replacement scorer or independent retry.
quality_only.usage_and_identity: Complete usage may remain null; partial counters retain original fields and explicit scope. Independently bind actual runtime/route/model/effort/parallel/child/helper/grader identities and attempt coverage. Cost, efficiency, savings and token-feature adoption remain HOLD.
quality_only.budget_gate: Keep enforced time/token/search/fetch limits and all shared non-usage gates. The proposed 200000-token envelope is still unenforced and blocks freeze; this amendment supplies no uncapped exception.

task_selection.rule: Eight lowest SHA256(seed_utf8 + decimal idx) from the pinned132-row question pool. This small bilingual sample is not domain/language-balanced.
task_selection.worker_view: Exact top-level prompt bytes plus one common frozen output contract only; content.rubric and content.blocked are grader-only.

arms.role: fixed matched reference; this study cannot replace GPTR

proposed_execution.native_internal_retries: Unqualified; GPTR helper max_attempts10 differs from SDK max_retries0. Bind each runtime before freeze.
proposed_execution.order: For each question in pinned order, run repeat1 then repeat2; rotate GPTR/DeerFlow/Onyx, DeerFlow/Onyx/GPTR, Onyx/GPTR/DeerFlow by zero-based question position for repeat1 and reverse that arm list for repeat2. Freeze all48 attempt records and grading order before outputs.
proposed_execution.fresh_state: One fresh native thread/session/index scope per attempt, identical public-source access rules and same frozen search/fetch services across arms.
proposed_execution.token_bound_status: Unenforced proposal; choose native enforcement, uncached/gross basis and breach disposition after canary and before freeze.
proposed_execution.quota_rule: Shared contract:429/account rotation/planned window end invalidates the whole task-repeat block including grading; retain failures and recover the whole block in the next recorded window. Maximum2 invalid blocks, no excluded tasks; third invalid block aborts.
proposed_execution.source_policy: Preserve each question's original time constraints. Bind an observation cutoff, archived/versioned eligibility where the prompt requires historical availability, URL/time/content hashes and fetch failures. Neither a current page nor a judge verdict proves historical availability.
proposed_execution.compression: off control; semantic no-cache bypass and unique correlation id required in every arm; retain upstream cache subsets and gateway interventions
proposed_execution.window: Exclusive architecture-owned throwaway GPT-pool window coordinated with session0c and client-token/GPU trials

runner.source_binding_status: Root original sources read at adopted0.3.273 pin; native binary C/I scorer, required grader role, criterion-in-Sample.target and zero-UNSCORED/full-coverage contract declared in inspect-grader-binding.json. Unchanged adopted-version controls, local rubric negative controls and live grader transport remain unrun/unqualified.

proposed_evaluation.citation_quality: Frozen locally authored strict support/attribution criterion in native Sample.target, run by standing Inspect model_graded_qa with unchanged default grading instructions/pattern, required grader role and partial_credit=false. Independently retained numbered passages are blinded to runtime identity. Missing evidence, wrong attribution, failed temporal eligibility, unsupported material claims, incorrect numeric values, units or denominators require I; only C counts as a supported report pass. Malformed/missing/off-menu/P verdicts are native UNSCORED, not success or quality zero; the whole matched task-repeat block becomes infrastructure-invalid. Require zero UNSCORED/errors and full frozen sample coverage.
proposed_evaluation.rubric_quality: Retain the unchanged official DRB-II report-rubric grader separately. Its report-text evidence is not source entailment; its score is never substituted for citation support.
proposed_evaluation.aggregation: Per question/arm, sum strict-supported report passes across two valid repeats (denominator2) and take the arithmetic mean of the unchanged official DRB-II rubric scores across those repeats. Report per-question scores, not only a pooled mean.
proposed_evaluation.footprint: Decision-relevant acceptance gate for passwordless admission and declared host resources; measured CPU/RAM/disk/service footprint otherwise report-only, not a post-hoc tiebreaker.
proposed_evaluation.decision_rule: Full_usage mode, unchanged lane reading of the inherited role labels: Onyx4.8.3 replaces DeerFlow2.1.0 only with no lower strict-supported report count and mean official rubric score on every matched question and at least one strict quality improvement. If every quality value ties, require at least5% lower paired median uncached-input-plus-output tokens with complete authoritative same-scope original gross-input/cache-read/output operands and no greater paired median agent time. Otherwise keep DeerFlow; incomparable admission or missing usage yields no claimed efficiency win. Fixed GPTR3.7.0 cannot be replaced by this study.
proposed_evaluation.limitations: No calibrated claim percentage, universal quality or statistical superiority follows this eight-question screen. The local citation rubric requires native fail-closed parse behavior and its negative controls before candidate outputs.

required_before_freeze: Astra/max consequential read and Claude-lane read of finalized source/task/rubric/route/extension contract, exact accepted head/hash and freeze receipt
Allocated native host/project/window, installed GPTR/DeerFlow entrypoints and separately scoped Onyx-Lite provisioning with immutable service/image pins
Same source-backed keyless search/fetch service pins, exact engine/language/result-count/quotas, common output contract and automated clarification-off setting
Exact org-owned extension/plugin/skill/MCP inventory and useful loader activation checks: GPTR plugin executable/Python-version contract; DeerFlow0.2 extensions; Onyx research/sandbox tools
Native configured OmniRoute build/carry and actual all-call effort across main/child/summary/title/auxiliary calls; preserve differing native/API effort semantics

Shared execution-contract acceptance, all48 ordered attempt records, owner-observed delivered reasoning/parallel fields and request-to-attempt binding in both modes; one complete authoritative usage aggregate per arm additionally required in full_usage

Native binary C/I grader contract accepted and unchanged parse controls plus locally authored support/numeric negative controls pass; any UNSCORED invalidates the block and cannot shrink the denominator
Source-backed evaluator/judge transport and frozen strict rubric; wrong-source, wrong-attribution, unsupported-claim, missing-source and temporal-violation negative controls before candidate outputs

Observable all-call native usage completeness in full_usage; original usage missingness/presence/types, scoped partial counters and independently bound treatment/attempt identities in quality_only; enforced time/token/search/fetch bounds, terminal results and independent actual report/source observations remain required in both modes

Quality_only requires accepted numeric per-question quality/challenger/tie rules and exact shared/job/preregistration reads; frozen strict Inspect and official DRB-II graders, original outcomes/coverage and all non-usage gates remain mandatory
Exact independent archive/availability rules and blinded source/report/rubric bindings; all failed attempts and unknown counters retained
failures_preserved: The first prompt-hash probe looked inside content instead of the top-level prompt field and returned eight empty-string hashes. Those hashes are invalid; the corrected top-level probe asserts nonempty UTF8 prompts and supplies the bindings above.

The inherited source report used Sol max and proposed DeepEval citation scoring. This separate user-directed ultra study uses the requested upstream evaluator family, with source/quality transport qualification still open.
